decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service moved from a mention in 2023 to a page of its own in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it fits con terra's core GeoIT security offering, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The open GIS framework has stayed at the level of a mention with no added emphasis, so its results are uncertain, but it supports the firm's established GIS development business and a medium firm's slack lets it carry the product for another year.
The identity service for GIS applications was promoted from a mention to its own page with more specific launch messaging, which shows performance meeting aspirations within a core competence.

The consulting workshop was just launched in 2024 with its own page and needs few resources, and it complements the firm's consultancy business, so it is too early to judge it against aspiration levels.
